pages.title: Hypernova Plasma
pages.text: Plasma from the most violent explosions in the universe. Hypernovae release more energy than ordinary supernovae and leave behind black holes. The plasma is hotter and denser than any star's core, and it wants to escape.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding a Hypernova Alloy Ingot and a Quark Star Core into the Transcendent Plasma Forge, the plasma that came out matched the conditions of a hypernova.
